newsitem.title: MEXICO: Arancia-CPC invests $100 mln in new Mexico plant.
newsitem.headline: Arancia-CPC invests $100 mln in new Mexico plant.

text.p: Arancia-CPC, a maker of corn derivatives, said on Wednesday it had invested $100 million in the expansion of a plant in the central Mexican state of Queretaro.

"Our company has completed an important investment of more than $100 million to increase production of starches and glucoses," director general Ignacio Aranguren said in a ceremony attended by U.S. President Ernesto Zedillo.
The plant was started in 1994, a product of the partnership between Grupo Arancia and CPC International Inc. It was said to be the biggest producer of corn derivatives in Latin America.
It aims to process some 1.25 million tonnes of corn. This year the company said it saw sales of $350 million and exports of $32.5 million.
